php56_attempt.interpretation: Confirmed by exact source: libzip1.2.0 hard-codes the sole zip target as SHARED and does not declare/consume BUILD_SHARED_LIBS. The commented zipstatic target is not built. Build log records only libzip.so install outputs; final-prefix inventory has those shared artifacts and no libzip.a. Therefore the archive was never generated/installed, not a Docker COPY omission or alternate path. CMakeCache/install_manifest were not captured, but source target definition and actual build/install output establish why.

upstream_source_review.finding: Exact libzip 1.2.0 source lib/CMakeLists.txt:194 declares ADD_LIBRARY(zip SHARED ...) unconditionally. Lines203-209 contain only a commented-out zipstatic target. Root CMakeLists has no BUILD_SHARED_LIBS declaration or use. Therefore -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF is passed by the Docker recipe but cannot alter this explicitly typed target. INSTALL(TARGETS zip) lists ARCHIVE and LIBRARY destinations; static archive output would be installed there after target correction.
